name: b0-detection-v1
description: B0 goal confirmation rule per ObjectNav category, chosen on the 6 DEV scenes from the phase-2 detector measurement (YOLOE-26m, OpenVINO GPU, taxonomy-v1, mapping goal-categories-v1). A candidate object is confirmed when >= min_views distinct frames detect the category on it at >= threshold; with vote the category must also be the most frequent goal category detected on that object. Target: <= ~1 wrongly confirmed object per scene. See docs/objectnav/phase2-detector-results.md.
